issues: All pages rendered rotated 90deg from portrait scan (landscape table content); no ТР ТС section headings present in this document (lab-accreditation scope for an environmental testing center, not a manufacturer's TR TS scope), so tr_section is null on every row. ОКПД2 and ТН ВЭД columns are '-' (null) for every row in the source. Rows 4, 12, 14, 15 give the range in two equivalent units (e.g. мкг/дм3 and мг/дм3, or гПа and кПа, or ЕМФ and мг/дм3); only the first-listed unit/range is captured in the structured fields, the second is preserved in raw_row_text. Row 10 and row 12 temperature ranges use '…' as separator (e.g. '(- 40…+ 85) °C'); parsed as range_from '-40', range_to '+85'.
